SELECT min(calendar_date) AS start_d, max(calendar_date) AS end_d, count(*) AS days, min(fiscal_week) mnw, max(fiscal_week) mxw
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3

SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
       min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-27' AND DATE '2026-08-10'

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
l AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN wd.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS bdate,
         s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END AS grp, staff_purchase_flag,
       count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, count(*) n_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN bdate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_dates
FROM l WHERE bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' OR bdate IS NULL
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT store_id, count(*) AS days, sum(receipts) AS receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS gross_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(receipts) receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,r.store_id) store_id, m.receipts mr, r.receipts rr, m.net mn, r.net rn, m.net-r.net diff
FROM m FULL JOIN r ON r.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.receipts IS DISTINCT FROM r.receipts OR abs(m.net-r.net)>0.005

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
         f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY 1
